# llms.txt — awareness-space (Consciousness Research)

> This file helps AI assistants and language models understand the structure and content of this site.

## Site Overview

This is the research site of pjdhiro exploring **what consciousness is** — starting from the Survival-Trust Axis hypothesis.

- **Primary Language**: Japanese (日本語), with English summaries
- **Site URL**: https://uminomae.github.io/awareness-space/
- **Topics**: Consciousness, Survival-Trust Axis, Intersubjectivity, Misapplication, Neurophenomenology, Negative Capability

## Core Concepts

### Survival-Trust Axis (生存-信頼軸)

An exploratory hypothesis positing that human conscious experience evaluates discrepancies and deficits along at least two directions:

#### Survival Axis (生存軸)

Evaluation of threat, safety, status, and resources. Bodily signals and prediction errors form the foundation of awareness along this axis. Includes not just physical danger but also social standing and resource preservation.

#### Trust Axis (信頼軸)

Evaluation of attachment, belonging, trust, and intersubjectivity. This axis asks how consciousness operates within relationships — how social signals shape our experience and sense of self.

#### Misapplication (誤適用)

Much human suffering may arise from attempting to solve trust-axis problems through survival-axis achievement. This misapplication structure is the core of the hypothesis.

### Intersubjectivity (間主観性)

Central to the trust axis. Intersubjectivity concerns the shared experiential space between subjects — how consciousness arises in relational encounters. It is not merely information exchange but experience sharing, and is a key investigative question of this exploration.

## Research Approach

- **Neurophenomenology**: Bridging first-person phenomenological experience with third-person neuroscience
- **Developmental Psychology**: Tracing how consciousness develops through early encounters
- **Exploratory Hypothesis**: The Survival-Trust Axis is a working hypothesis under investigation, not an adopted certainty

## Important Note

This research is in progress. It distinguishes between established knowledge (body, prediction, emotion, sociality) and what is still hypothesis (the survival-trust axis framework). This uncertainty is made explicit throughout.
